build_pretrained_model: build a pretrained PyTorchVideo model by calling hub_model_builder with pretrained=True and a checkpoint URL
build_model_with_defaults: build a PyTorchVideo model using hub_model_builder with default_config to set fallback argument values
build_model_from_builder_func: build a PyTorchVideo model by passing a model builder function and kwargs to hub_model_builder
review_hub_model_builder: review the hub_model_builder function to understand how it merges default_config with kwargs before calling the builder
summarize_hub_model_builder: summarize the hub_model_builder function that constructs models and optionally loads pretrained weights from a checkpoint URL
